narr.Aqua Kyoto Paris: W36 users 4,625 with 286 GA4 bookings, both down on W35 (5,395 users, 356 bookings) and the lowest of the last four weeks; conversion rate 6.2%. The year-ago week is a launch spike, not a trading base: 6 to 12 Oct 2025 returned 13,524 users off 29,496 sessions (2.18 sessions per user) with only 13.8% new users, so users read down 66% YoY while GA4 bookings are exactly level at 286 and conversion rate is up from 2.1% to 6.2%. Read the bookings line, not the users line. Ad spend rose to €3,223 from €2,674 while ad-driven bookings fell to 85 from 96, so blended CPA went to €37.91 from €27.85. Google took €1,548, the highest of the eight weeks shown, for 46 bookings at €33.65 CPA; Meta took €1,675 for 39 bookings at €42.94, its worst CPA in the eight weeks. The Google rise is concentrated in one campaign, Search FR Rooftop Vue et Soiree, which went from €221 to €413 and returned 9.7 bookings.

Aqua Kyoto Paris: GA4 went live late 2025, so the year-ago weeks are real readings but W36 last year is a launch traffic spike, not a comparable trading base
